Public presence and factual corrections

Basic profile discovery, source-backed directory visibility, source/currentness information and factual corrections remain free whether or not an organization joins.

Important boundary

Membership is participation—not endorsement.

Payment does not buy ranking, credentials, suitability, leads, customers, sales, revenue or guaranteed results. Franklin Navigator is independent and is not a government agency.

Who may participate

Franklin first, with accurate Franklin-area participation.

Organizations physically in Franklin are the core. Williamson County organizations and qualified organizations within about 25 miles of Franklin city limits may request an accurately labeled Franklin-area profile when they serve or want to participate in Franklin. We never relabel an outlying location as physically located in Franklin.

Enrollment status: secure live checkout is still closed while the Franklin membership runtime, V4 provider mapping and controlled transaction are completed. Use “Show me my member profile” today; it creates no payment.
